ledger.claim: The rider does not contest arrival. POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied on the driver's own trace: EV-GPS-09101 places the driver a mean 24.0 m from the pickup pin on all 33 fixes, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, at 100% coverage with no gap, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is made out and the rider gains nothing on that limb.

The rider does not contest the dwell either. EV-GPS-09101 shows a single qualifying in-geofence run running from 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation - 320 seconds - against the 300 second STANDARD minimum that POL-NS-06 fixes for this zone class. There is no shortfall on the longest run and no second in-geofence interval to accumulate, so POL-NS-06 can yield the rider no refund and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met.

POL-NS-04 cannot carry the rider. EV-CHAT-09101 holds three messages and none is from the rider, so limb (a) - a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window - is unmet; the driver replied 14 seconds after the arrival notice and again at 08:14:10, so limb (b) is unmet; and the rider's track on EV-GPS-09101 is a single fixed position roughly 519 m from the pin across all 15 of its fixes, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius limb (c) requires. The rider was stationary at 0 km/h throughout that window, which is consistent with his account that he was waiting, but the record does not place that waiting at the pickup. The rider notes that the bundle does not expose the per-fix accuracy readings, so had those fixes been dropped for accuracy the limb would be undecidable rather than failed; that cannot rescue the clause, because limbs (a) and (b) fail independently.

The remaining rider routes are closed on the same record. POL-NS-03 cannot fire because the driver's fixes sit inside the arrival radius, not outside it within the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-05 cannot fire because at the 08:10:20 arrival event the trace puts the driver 24 m from the pin at 0 km/h - neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-08 leaves no defect to exploit: no sampling gap exceeds 120 seconds, the chat log carries the 3 messages the trip record counts, and the 4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so the fare line reconciles under the resolution rule.
Limb (a) of the baseline no-show test is satisfied: the trip record for TRP-09101 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00, and the driver is the party who terminated the trip.

Limb (b) is satisfied on the arrival geofence test. All 33 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the pickup pin - min, mean and max are the same 24.01 m figure - well inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone class. The trace opens at 08:10:00, twenty seconds BEFORE the 08:10:20 'arrived' event, so the driver was inside the geofence at or before that event as the clause requires. Qualifying driver fixes number 33 of 33, so there are far more than the three consecutive in-radius readings POL-NS-02 demands.

Limb (c) is satisfied. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 320 continuous seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, against a STANDARD minimum dwell of 300 seconds. The derived shortfall is MINUS 20 seconds - that is, a 20 second surplus, not a shortfall. The point is robust even on the driver's own less favourable reading: measured from the 'arrived' marker at 08:10:20 to cancellation at 08:15:20 is exactly 300 seconds, still at the minimum. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying GPS fix, per the clause, and not from the arrival tap.

Limb (d) is satisfied. The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises - at the very moment the 320 second dwell elapsed, and it records no boarding event anywhere.

The arrival marker is TRUE, so POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee. At the arrived timestamp the trace reports a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph - the driver was stationary, not travelling - and his position was 24 m from the pin, roughly one twelfth of the 300 m distance threshold and nowhere near the 15 kph motion threshold. This is not a driver tapping 'arrived' while rolling down an expressway; it is a driver parked at the pickup point.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. The driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue 400 m away, so the wrong-entrance route does not arise. Independently, the driver's in-app message at 08:10:35 states he is 'at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310', and the trip record's registered pickup bears venue_id VEN-CLEMENTI-310 with the label 'Blk 310 Clementi Ave 4, sheltered pickup point'. That is a party statement in the chat log matching the registered venue, not an inference from geography.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails outright. The chat log for the waiting window contains no rider message at all: three messages only - the system notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 08:10:21, and two driver messages at 08:10:35 and 08:14:10. Limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message FROM THE RIDER, and there is none. The message_count of 3 in the chat log also matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, so the log is not truncated.

The rider's own track does not place them at the pickup point, and cannot support limb (c) of POL-NS-04 either. The rider track carries 15 fixes and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 of 15; every fix sits 519.37 m from the pin, far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. I put it precisely: whether those fixes are excluded because they fall outside the radius or are filtered for accuracy, limb (c) is at best undecidable and neutral and at worst affirmatively failed on admissible fixes - on no reading does it place the rider within 100 m of the pin. The rider's assertion that they were 'downstairs' is not borne out by their own device.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so POL-NS-06 is not engaged and the fee is not refundable on that route. I disclose that the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. The driver does not rely on limb (i) accumulation and does not need to: the dwell was one single continuous in-geofence run of 320 seconds, so no advisory is required to join intervals together, and I assert nothing against the missing artifact.

The money reconciles. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule; the two dimensions agree, the fare breakdown's difference field reads 0.00, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. The fee therefore stands as itemised.

No artifact that carries a deciding fact is impaired, so POL-NS-09(a) and (e) are not engaged. The trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0: 100 per cent coverage, 33 fixes at a 10 second cadence equal to the expected interval, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. The 08:10:20 'arrived' event coincides exactly with a fix, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a); the log's 3 messages match the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(c) chat defect; and the fee reconciles under POL-NS-08(d). Deciding facts rest on clean, weight-1.0 artifacts.

No abuse or repeat-dispute trigger is present. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not met. I cite only the fields the clause names.

The driver is entitled to compensation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 - with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached and compensation is not withheld. I rely only on the two fields POL-NS-07 names, no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d; prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and I do not use it.

ledger.claim: On the charge itself the disposition is that the present state stands: fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the evidence does not support the rider's claim to have the charge reversed. Under POL-GEN-03 that is NO_ACTION on the fee, while the case as a whole produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.20 in the driver's favour.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your request to reverse the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not supported on this record. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20 for TRP-09101. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-09101 opens at 08:10:00 with a fix 24.01 m from the pickup pin, and every one of the driver's 33 fixes sits at that same 24.01 m — inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and more than the three consecutive in-radius readings POL-NS-02 requires — so the driver was inside the geofence at or before the arrival event. (c) He then held position inside the geofence continuously from 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation: 320 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires (the derived shortfall of -20 seconds is a 20-second surplus). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, at the moment the 300-second dwell elapsed, and no boarding event is recorded. Your account that you were 'downstairs' is not borne out by your own device: the rider track places you about 519 m from the pin across all 15 of its fixes. You also sent no message in the app during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails and that clause does not exonerate you. POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue within 400 m). POL-NS-05 does not apply — the 'arrived' marker coincides with a stationary fix at 0 km/h, 24 m from the pin, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h thresholds, so it is not a false marker. POL-NS-06 does not apply — there is no dwell shortfall. The driver's 08:10:35 chat message naming the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310 matches the registered pickup venue, so the pickup point is established on a party statement, not on general geography.

To the driver: your no-show is verified and your time is compensated. Under POL-NS-07 you receive 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20 — with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached and compensation is not withheld. The charge itself stands as itemised: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule as the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

Evidence integrity: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not relied upon — the dwell was one single continuous in-geofence run, so no advisory is needed to join intervals, and nothing is asserted against it. Apart from that artifact, no evidence relied upon is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): there is no clock skew (the 08:10:20 arrival event coincides with a fix), no trace gap (100% coverage, 33 fixes at a 10-second cadence, zero gaps), no chat defect (the log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3), and no fare defect. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present either: confidence is well above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the same-party dispute counters are both 0, no anti-farming pattern trips, and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact. The case is therefore decided on the record. The rule that the fee stands is the disposition of the charge under POL-GEN-03; the outcome this case produces is the driver compensation, so amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20 figure as driver_compensation_sgd.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
